title: Formspec Identity Binding Profile
description: A sidecar profile declaring how a Formspec deployment binds signer, filer, or agent identity evidence into provider-neutral Formspec identity surfaces. The v1 profile includes a WebAuthn/FIDO2/passkey binding that references upstream WebAuthn assertion and verification artifacts without embedding raw authenticator bytes in the sidecar.

$formspecIdentityBindingProfile.description: Identity Binding Profile specification version. MUST be '1.0'.

x-lm.intent: Document marker for the Identity Binding Profile sidecar

version.description: Version of this Identity Binding Profile document. SemVer is RECOMMENDED.

profileId.description: Stable URI identifying this profile document.

targetDefinition.description: The Formspec Definition this identity-binding profile applies to.

profiles.description: One or more identity-binding profiles available for the target Definition.

x-lm.intent: Declares the available identity binding contracts for the Definition

id.description: Stable local profile identifier unique within this document.

purpose.description: Identity-binding use case this profile supports.

x-lm.intent: Separates signer, filer, reviewer, agent, and session identity concerns

subjectKind.description: Kind of subject the profile is allowed to authenticate.

assuranceFloor.description: Minimum assurance level this profile is intended to satisfy.

nistAssuranceFloor.description: Optional NIST SP 800-63 IAL/AAL/FAL floor mapped from the normalized identity-attestation shape.

identityProviderRef.description: URI for the provider, relying party, issuer, or adapter family that supplies this profile.

evidenceBindings.description: Provider-neutral Formspec fields where captured identity evidence is referenced.

SubjectKind.description: Identity subject class. Deployment-specific classes MUST use x- prefix.

BindingMethod.description: Identity-binding method family. Deployment-specific methods MUST use x- prefix.

fal.description: NIST federation assurance level floor when federation applies.

identityClaimEvidenceRef.description: formspec-web IdentityProvider evidence pointer that captures provider evidence by reference.

x-lm.intent: Binds adapter evidence into the normalized IdentityProvider claim instead of provider-native fields

authoredSignatureIdentityBinding.description: Response authored-signature field that records the provider-neutral binding result.

x-lm.intent: Binds profile output to the existing Response authored-signature identityBinding field

externalAttestationRef.description: Response authored-signature field that references external identity-attestation evidence.

ledgerAttestationEvidenceRef.description: Optional respondent-ledger evidence reference for deployments that emit identity-attestation ledger events.

rpId.description: WebAuthn relying-party identifier expected in authenticator data verification.

x-lm.intent: Pins the WebAuthn relying-party boundary for verifier checks

origins.description: Allowed HTTPS origins that may request this WebAuthn assertion.

x-lm.intent: Pins the browser origin set for WebAuthn clientDataJSON verification

userVerification.description: SC-4 WebAuthn profiles require per-act user verification for signer identity binding.

x-lm.intent: Requires PIN, biometric, or equivalent authenticator-local verification

credentialRegistryRef.description: Registry or provider endpoint that maps credential IDs to normalized subject identity and assurance metadata.

authenticatorAttachment.description: Authenticator attachment posture accepted by this profile.

attestationConveyance.description: WebAuthn attestation conveyance preference for enrollment.

duressCredentialSupport.description: Optional FW-0048 composition hint. dual-passkey-convention means the provider registry can distinguish normal and duress credentials after an otherwise standard WebAuthn ceremony.

challengeBinding.description: Canonical challenge preimage binding used for assertion verification.

assertionBinding.description: Artifact and Response-field bindings for verified WebAuthn assertions.

domainSeparator.description: Domain separator for the WebAuthn challenge preimage.

x-lm.intent: Keeps WebAuthn challenge bytes disjoint from other Formspec signature preimages

signedPayloadDigestBinding.description: Existing signed-payload digest field committed by the WebAuthn challenge.

x-lm.intent: Binds the WebAuthn assertion to the existing Formspec signed-payload digest

includeOrigin.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include the expected origin.

includeRpId.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include the expected RP ID.

includeSignerId.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include the signer identifier.

includeSigningIntent.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include the signing intent URI.

includeNonce.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include a fresh single-use nonce.

includePostureSnapshot.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include a posture snapshot identifier when posture gates apply.

includeSignatureMethodRegistrySnapshot.description: The canonical challenge structure MUST include the signature-method registry snapshot identifier.

signatureMethod.description: Signature-method registry URI for the WebAuthn/FIDO2/passkey profile.

x-lm.intent: Pins the SC-4 WebAuthn method URI

signatureArtifactKind.description: Existing polymorphic signature artifact kind that stores raw WebAuthn assertion bytes outside this sidecar.

validationArtifactKind.description: Verifier-attested validation artifact kind for COSE-only downstream consumers.

responseIdentityBindingMethod.description: AuthoredSignature.identityBinding.method value produced for this profile.
